subject: Acme Fasteners is now part of Titan Industrial Group
text:
Dear Valued Customer,

We are pleased to announce that Titan Industrial Group has completed its acquisition of Acme Fasteners LLC. Your contacts, pricing and lead times are unchanged.

What changes for you:

- Invoices dated on or after December 1 will be issued by Titan Industrial Group Inc, EIN 84-3390117.
- All remittances, including payment of open Acme Fasteners invoices, should be sent to Titan's lockbox or bank account. A W-9 and bank letter are attached.
- Please update your supplier records to reflect the new legal entity name.

Titan Industrial Group Inc
Remit by ACH: Routing 091000019, Account 2210984477, U.S. Bank
Remit by check: Titan Industrial Group Inc, Dept 3310, PO Box 86410, Minneapolis MN 55486

Questions may be directed to ar@titanindustrial.com.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

note: Merger announcement that moves the vendor's payments to the acquirer's account, including payment of existing Acme invoices.
